programme.title: Nothing to see / Niks te zien
programme.desc: With the legendary Dana Winner goes to Sicily with the legendary Dana, not with their eyes but with their ears. In the land of love they fall from one serenade to the other, they venture to a typical Sicilian mouth harp and go to the most active volcano in Europe - Spoiler: it is not the Etna - who shows and see every 15 minutes. And although the latter does not apply to Karl, they still hope for a miracle. At the end of the journey, Dana brings a serenade with a new song as a reminder. / Slechtziende Karl Meesters trekt met de legendarische Dana Winner naar Sicilië, niet met hun ogen maar met hun oren op scherp. In het land van de liefde vallen ze van de ene serenade in de andere, wagen ze zich aan een typische Siciliaanse mondharp en trekken ze naar de actiefste vulkaan van Europa - spoiler: het is niet de Etna - die zich elk kwartier laat horen en zien. En hoewel dat laatste niet geldt voor Karl, hopen ze toch op een mirakel. Als afsluiter van de reis brengt Dana zelf een serenade met een nieuw nummer als herinnering.

programme.title: Taking care of Mama / Zorgen voor mama
programme.desc: Amber asked Kristel and Fatih - after her forced admission - to continue the help. She needs a medical file with the doctor, and then to be able to submit her support request to the FPS. Deborah goes to the social housing company with An to discuss the problems about the rent and various defects in the apartment. She also receives news from the debt mediator from the collective of Tommy, and tries to help An with her finances. Joost thinks it's time to get extra help for Wendy. He wants to request urgent support from the OCMW, and Fatih ask for help in connection with teenage daughter Davina. / Amber heeft Kristel en Fatih - na haar gedwongen opname - gevraagd om de hulp verder te zetten. Ze heeft een medisch dossier nodig bij de huisarts, om vervolgens haar steunaanvraag bij de FOD te kunnen indienen. Deborah gaat met An naar de sociale huisvestingsmaatschappij om de problemen omtrent de huur en diverse mankementen in het appartement te bespreken. Ze krijgt ook nieuws van de schuldbemiddelaar van de collectieve van Tommy, en probeert An te helpen met haar financiën.Joost vindt het tijd om voor Wendy extra hulp in te schakelen. Hij wil dringende steun aanvragen bij het OCMW, en Fatih om hulp vragen in verband met tienerdochter Davina.

programme.title: Lou / Lou
programme.desc: Animation series about the daily life of the 12-year-old girl Lou and her friends who are on the threshold of adolescence. Based on the comics of the same name by Julien Neel. / Animatiereeks over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou en haar vrienden die op de drempel van de adolescentie staan. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van Julien Neel.

programme.title: Dodo / Dodo
programme.desc: Joe is convinced that the first prize in the poetry match is a game console and wants to win at all costs. Even if that means that he loses his friendship with Pete. / Joe is ervan overtuigd dat de eerste prijs in de poëziewedstrijd een spelconsole is en wil die koste wat kost winnen. Zelfs als dat betekent dat hij daardoor zijn vriendschap met Pete verliest.

programme.title: De Faker / De Faker
programme.desc: At first glance it seems like a normal family, but something is wrong. One of the family members has been replaced by an actor or actress. Will the Heritier succeed in discovering who does not belong to the De Medts family? This cozy family from Maarkedal lives on a farm and will not make the heritier easy. Heritier will have to bring out his best tracking techniques to expose the faker. Nidal and Thomas follow the search of Heritier from the Fakerbus and hope that he will bring in a point for their team. / Op het eerste gezicht lijkt het een doodgewoon gezin, maar er klopt iets niet. Een van de gezinsleden is namelijk vervangen door een acteur of actrice. Lukt het Heritier om te ontdekken wie er niet thuishoort bij de Familie De Medts? Deze gezellige familie uit Maarkedal woont op een boerderij en zal het Heritier niet gemakkelijk maken. Heritier gaat zijn beste speurtechnieken moeten bovenhalen om de Faker te ontmaskeren. Nidal en Thomas volgen vanuit de Fakerbus de zoektocht van Heritier en hopen dat hij een punt voor hun team zal binnenhalen.

programme.title: Karrewiet with VGT / Karrewiet Met VGT

Getolkt in Vlaamse Gebarentaal (VGT). Ook beschikbaar op Ketnet.be, via de KetnetVideo-app en via Net gemist.

programme.title: Hello croquette / Hallo Kroket
programme.desc: Daily live show in which the Ketnet wrappers pull you into the world of Ketnet and those of the Ketnetters. Expect famous guests, crazy scoops, fun performances, exciting games and so much more. Hello croquette! / Dagelijkse liveshow waarin de KETNET-wrappers je meetrekken in de wereld van KETNET en die van de Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET!

programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: Caro has to leave everything and everyone. Together with Scott, she goes out for a day. Soon everyone is worried about where the two are. Scott is vulnerable and tells about his sister. In the meantime, Saskia is busy planning. / Caro moet even weg van alles en iedereen. Samen met Scott trekt ze er een dagje op uit. Al snel is iedereen ongerust over waar de twee naartoe zijn. Scott stelt zich kwetsbaar op en vertelt over zijn zus. Ondertussen is Saskia druk bezig met plannen.

programme.title: Girls / Meisjes
programme.desc: Amelie, Cleo, Fleur and Luna are best friends and together they experience all kinds of adventures. The young girls can count on each other's support at school and they also stand their ground together in the outside world. / Amelie, Cleo, Fleur en Luna zijn beste vriendinnen en samen beleven ze allerlei avonturen. De jonge meiden kunnen op elkaars steun rekenen op school en ook in de buitenwereld staan ze samen hun mannetje.

programme.title: Break / Kapot Gaan
programme.desc: Sarah, Nona and Gloria will break this episode from the depth. They get all the principles of diving and eventually see who dares to go the deepest. / Sarah, Nona en Gloria gaan deze aflevering kapot van de diepte. Ze krijgen alle beginselen van het duiken uitgelegd en kijken uiteindelijk wie het diepst durft gaan.

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Most students are in the well because they do not know what they want to be later. Soekie wants to help them choose to find their passion, by inviting a successful former student to school. The ex-student is a well-known actor from the soap "Morningzon". Soekies Action has a counterproductive effect: all students want to become an actor to be rich and famous. They can all audition for "morning sun" but none of them is good enough. Everyone is even deeper into the well. / De meeste leerlingen zitten in de put omdat ze niet weten wat ze later willen worden. Soekie wil hen helpen bij hun keuze om hun passie te vinden, door een succesvolle ex-leerling uit te nodigen op school. De ex-leerling is een bekende acteur uit de soap "Morgenzon". Soekies actie heeft een averechts effect: alle leerlingen willen acteur worden om ook rijk en beroemd te zijn. Ze mogen allemaal auditie doen voor "Morgenzon" maar niemand van hen is goed genoeg. Iedereen zit nu nog dieper in de put.

programme.title: Stip it: the pest glasses / Stip it: de pestbril
programme.desc: Juul was born with only a thumb on his right hand. Nevertheless, he knows how to save himself, but there are that they laugh at him. Not okay, say the children of the plague glasses and Lee Arrendell fully agrees with that! / Juul werd geboren met aan zijn rechterhandje enkel een duim. Desondanks weet hij zich uitstekend te redden, maar toch zijn er die hem daarom uitlachen. Niet oke!, zeggen de kinderen van het pestbrilpanel en daar gaat Lee Arrendell volmondig mee akkoord!

programme.title: The mustard of Meus / De mosterd van Meus
programme.desc: Jeroen Meus crosses Turkey, melting pot of cultures and flavors. TV -Kok Refika Birgul serves Jeroen her best travel tips and - of course - tea for. In this way he learns to make Pezmek, visits a buffalo farm and runs with a traditional potter. Of course, a kebab on the road should not be missing either. Finally, Jeroen is a guest on a traditional gold day where he is treated to a wonderful feast. Nowhere do the Sarma, Dolma and Baklava taste better. / Jeroen Meus doorkruist Turkije, smeltkroes van culturen en smaken. Tv-kok Refika Birgul schotelt Jeroen haar beste reistips en - uiteraard - thee voor. Zo leert hij pezmek maken, bezoekt hij een buffelboerderij en draait hij mee met een ambachtelijke pottenbakker. Natuurlijk mag een kebab onderweg ook niet ontbreken. Tot slot is Jeroen te gast op een traditionele Gouddag waar hij getrakteerd wordt op een heerlijk feestmaal. Nergens smaken de sarma, dolma en baklava beter.

programme.desc: Evis great -grandfather accompanied stupid films on his cello. A timeless piece of history that expert Ruben does not want to be lost. Een tijdloos stukje geschiedenis dat expert Ruben niet verloren wil laten gaan. Bart staat voor een grote uitdaging bij de restauratie van een imposant gipsen beeld, en Wolfgang probeert opnieuw klank te toveren uit een nostalgische transistorradio.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: My country / Moja zemlja
programme.desc: A show dedicated to Bosnia and Herzegovina and us in it, people, lives, destinies, what people live, what they would like to improve, indicate or preserve for some new generations. The land is not (just) space, not just mountains, rivers, valleys, land, above all, are people. The land does not make flags, political pamphlets, the land is made up of ordinary people with everyday lives, joys and sadness ... This and such a country speaks a new series of the BHT1 Information Program, "My Land", which edits and, driving its Oldtimer from the end to the end of the Wonderful Bosnia and Herzegovina, leads Elvir Bucalo. / Emisija posvećena Bosni i Hercegovini i nama u njoj, ljudima, životima, sudbinama, onome što ljudi žive, što bi htjeli popraviti, ukazati ili sačuvati za neke nove generacije. Zemlja nije (samo) prostor, nisu samo planine, rijeke, doline, zemlja su, prije svega, ljudi. Zemlju ne čine zastave, politički pamfleti, zemlju čine obični ljudi sa svakodnevnim životima, radostima i tugama... O toj i takvoj zemlji govori novi serijal Informativnog programa BHT1, "Moja zemlja", koji uređuje i, vozeći svoj oldtimer obilazi s kraja na kraj čudesne Bosne i Hercegovine, vodi Elvir Bucalo.

It will reveal how the novel house was created in the prairie, and participates in marking the damage Dakota Sioux Indians. He will learn to play Lacrosse. In the continuation of the journey, Mississippi River remains and enters the Federal Wisconsin State. He learns how cranberries are harvested and how a photograph is developed that can record a movement. / Putovanje duž rijeke Mississippi, dijelovima na kojima su velikog utjecaja imali bjelački doseljenici. U nastavku putovanja iza njega ostaje rijeka Mississippi i ulazi u saveznu državu Wisconsin. Saznaje kako se beru brusnice i kako je razvijena fotografija koja može zabilježiti pokret.

programme.title: Football: League 1 of France: 5 round: Strasbourg - Marseille / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 5 кръг: Страсбург - Марсилия
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later, the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E32, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E32, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Can I work too? / Mogu li i ja raditi?
programme.desc: Can I work too? - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2022) Toni, Ivan, Marina, Ivica and Mateja are young people who were born with Down syndrome. They are an example of how there is no prejudice and how, with a lot of will, desire, effort and environmental help, they can succeed and make their dreams come true. Many people don't like their job. Many grunt and will get up every morning and start their work day again. But Toni, Ivan, Marina, Ivica and Mateja can hardly wait for a weekend and can get up early on Monday, get ready and go to work for themselves. They simply love to work, they love their colleagues at work and nothing is difficult for them. What are young people who we could learn a lot about the value of work and respect for colleagues, reveals this documentary. R.: Ljiljana Bunjevac Filipovic ... / Mogu li i ja raditi? - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2022) Tonija, Ivan, Marina, Ivica i Mateja mladi su ljudi koji su se rodili sa sindromom Down. Oni su primjer kako ne treba imati predrasuda i kako, uz puno volje, želje, truda i pomoći okoline, mogu uspjeti i ostvariti svoje snove. Mnogi ljudi ne vole svoj posao. Mnogi gunđaju i preko volje svako jutro ustaju i ponovno započinju svoj radni dan. Ali Tonija, Ivan, Marina, Ivica i Mateja jedva čekaju da prođe vikend i da mogu u ponedjeljak rano ustati, spremiti se i sami krenuti na posao. Jednostavno, vole raditi, vole svoje kolege na poslu i ništa im nije teško. Kakvi su to mladi ljudi od kojih bismo mogli naučiti puno o vrijednosti rada i poštivanju kolega, otkriva ovaj dokumentarni film. R.: Ljiljana Bunjevac Filipović...

programme.title: Can I work too? / Mogu li i ja raditi?
programme.desc: Can I work too? - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2022) Toni, Ivan, Marina, Ivica and Mateja are young people who were born with Down syndrome. They are an example of how there is no prejudice and how, with a lot of will, desire, effort and environmental help, they can succeed and make their dreams come true. Many people don't like their job. Many grunt and will get up every morning and start their work day again. But Toni, Ivan, Marina, Ivica and Mateja can hardly wait for a weekend and can get up early on Monday, get ready and go to work for themselves. They simply love to work, they love their colleagues at work and nothing is difficult for them. What are young people who we could learn a lot about the value of work and respect for colleagues, reveals this documentary. R.: Ljiljana Bunjevac Filipovic ... / Mogu li i ja raditi? - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2022) Tonija, Ivan, Marina, Ivica i Mateja mladi su ljudi koji su se rodili sa sindromom Down. Oni su primjer kako ne treba imati predrasuda i kako, uz puno volje, želje, truda i pomoći okoline, mogu uspjeti i ostvariti svoje snove. Mnogi ljudi ne vole svoj posao. Mnogi gunđaju i preko volje svako jutro ustaju i ponovno započinju svoj radni dan. Ali Tonija, Ivan, Marina, Ivica i Mateja jedva čekaju da prođe vikend i da mogu u ponedjeljak rano ustati, spremiti se i sami krenuti na posao. Jednostavno, vole raditi, vole svoje kolege na poslu i ništa im nije teško. Kakvi su to mladi ljudi od kojih bismo mogli naučiti puno o vrijednosti rada i poštivanju kolega, otkriva ovaj dokumentarni film. R.: Ljiljana Bunjevac Filipović...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E32, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E32, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E33, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E33, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Celine Dion - The Star was born / Celine Dion - Zvijezda je rođena
programme.desc: Celine Dion à Leurovision: La Note Parfaite - (Doc. Film, Switzerland, 2024) Today, this story seems completely impossible. Celine Dion, a planetary star and the most famous Kvebečanka in the world, defended the colors of Switzerland in the late 1980s on the most beautiful Eurosong in history. How is that possible? But that was by no means a coincidence. On the contrary, this fact tells us a lot about the career of the singer and collaboration with Rene Angelil, her manager and her only love. Their alliance lasted for over 40 years, while at the same time he was romantic and calculated, tasty and confusing honest. Her adventure at the Eurovision Song Contest was an opportunity to win new markets and a great risk of producer. Thanks to this, 600 million spectators have revealed that she has transformed herself into an artist and that the girl's old -fashioned looks and irregular teeth became a girl ready to grab her opportunity. Even ten years after that victory of Celine Dion, they chose to sing My Heart Will Go On, a song that marked the movie Titanic and, like a movie, echoed all over the world. Her professional climb was unstoppable. Already on the basis of a competition where she won the hair, it could be seen that a young woman would be a competitive spirit. She is a winner today, but she was then a fighter they chose to represent a particular group or goal. And so Switzerland entered history as a country that made Celine Dion first victory. R .: Vincent Gonon Ul.: Scott Fitzgerald, Atilla Sereftug, Bernard Thurnheer, Grimaud Valentin, Laurent Lederer (Self) ... / Celine Dion à lEurovision : La note parfaite - (dok. film, Švicarska, 2024) Danas se ta priča čini posve nemogućom. Celine Dion, planetarna zvijezda i najpoznatija Kvebečanka u svijetu, potkraj 1980-ih branila je boje Švicarske na najpamtljivijem Eurosongu u povijesti. Kako je to moguće? No to nipošto nije bila slučajnost. Naprotiv, ta nam činjenica na više načina govori mnogo o karijeri pjevačice i suradnji s Reneom Angelilom, njezinim menadžerom i njezinom jedinom ljubavi. Njihov savez je trajao više od 40 godina, a istodobno je bio romantičan i proračunat, razmetljiv i zbunjujuće iskren. Njezina pustolovina na Eurosongu bila je prilika za osvajanje novih tržišta i veliki rizik producenta. Zahvaljujući tome, 600 milijuna gledatelja otkrilo je kako se preobrazila u umjetnicu i kako je djevojčica staromodna izgleda i nepravilnih zuba postala djevojka spremna ugrabiti svoju priliku. Ni deset godina nakon te pobjede Celine Dion odabrali su da pjeva My Heart Will Go On, pjesmu koja je obilježila film Titanic i koja je, poput filma, odjeknula u cijelom svijetu. Njezin profesionalni uspon bio je nezaustavljiv. Već na temelju natjecanja na kojem je za dlaku pobijedila moglo se vidjeti da će mlada žena biti natjecateljskog duha. Danas je pobjednica, ali tada je bila borac kojeg su odabrali da zastupa određenu skupinu ili cilj. I tako je Švicarska ušla u povijest kao zemlja koja je Celine Dion omogućila prvu pobjedu. R.: Vincent Gonon Ul.: Scott Fitzgerald, Atilla Sereftug, Bernard Thurnheer, Grimaud Valentin, Laurent Lederer (Self)...

programme.title: Rick Stein i njegov Cornwall / Rick Stein i njegov Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick Steins Cornwall - (S01, E10, Educational Program, England, 2021) Rick Stein descends in Cornwall's bowels, in the Kaolin mine, to learn more about what they call white gold and one of the most industries of this area. Then he climbs the "Cornwol Alps", huge piles of stones, by-products of clay mining, which are among the highest "hills" in the Cornwall. After swimming in one of the idyllic hidden bays Rick prepares a simple dish of Luin and reveals us how to make perfect mayonnaise. In the extreme west of the County, on the Lands End peninsula, Rick introduces us to his niece, a painter who explains his deep spiritual connection with Cornwall. R.: Matt Bennett ... / Rick Steins Cornwall - (S01, E10, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2021) Rick Stein spušta se u utrobu Cornwalla, u rudnik kaolina, kako bi saznao više o onome što zovu bijelim zlatom i jednoj od najvažnijih industrija ovoga kraja. Zatim se penje na "kornvolske Alpe", goleme hrpe kamenja, nusproizvoda rudarenja gline, koje su među najvišim "brdima" u Cornwallu. Nakon kupanja u jednoj od idiličnih skrovitih uvala Rick priprema jednostavno jelo od lubina te nam otkriva kako napraviti savršenu majonezu. Na krajnjem zapadu grofovije, na poluotoku Lands End, Rick nas upoznaje sa svojom nećakinjom, slikaricom koja objašnjava svoju duboku duhovnu povezanost s Cornwallom. R.: Matt Bennett...

programme.title: Enrico Marotti: This is my float / Enrico Marotti: Ovo je moj plov
programme.desc: Enrico Marotti: This is my float - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2021) when in September 2019 Enrico Marotti won the first "Ploce" at the Denmark World Cup, it was the highlight of his sports career. The crown for thousands of hours he spent at sea, for effort, which in "small" sports, such as sailing on the board, often unjustly remained aside. The victory in Denmark, in the competition of the best board of the board, was also a kind of turning point for Marotti, who ended the season among the top ten sailors in the world. It all started in Volosko, a small town near Opatija, and Preluk Bay, where almost every day in the early morning between five and seven o'clock the north wind blows, Tramontana, which is an ideal polygon for sailboats from Kvarner. As Enrico Marotti grew up near Preluka, it was quite normal for the optimist to be enrolled as a child in the class of Opatija's sailboat. In the younger ages, Enrico did not achieve notable sports results, but that is why he fell in love with sports and sailing, which was a great pad for sailing on a board in which he became national champion at the age of 19. The passion for sailing, perseverance and work brought him near the world's top. His goal, he says, is to reach the top and stay there. R .: Rela Makya Ul.: Enrico Marotti (Self) ... / Enrico Marotti: Ovo je moj plov - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2021) Kad je u rujnu 2019. godine Enrico Marotti osvojio prvi "plov" na Svjetskom kupu u Danskoj, bio je to vrhunac njegove sportske karijere. Kruna za tisuće sati koje je proveo na moru, za trud, koji u "malim" sportovima, kao što je jedrenje na dasci, često nepravedno ostane po strani. Pobjeda u Danskoj, u konkurenciji najboljih svjetskih jedriličara na dasci, bila je i svojevrsna prekretnica za Marottija koji je sezonu završio među deset najboljih jedriličara na svijetu. Sve je krenulo u Voloskom, malom mjestu pokraj Opatije, i uvali Preluk gdje gotovo svaki dan u rano jutro između pet i sedam sati puše sjeverni vjetar, tramontana, što predstavlja idealan poligon za jedriličare s Kvarnera. Kako je Enrico Marotti odrastao u blizini Preluke, bilo je sasvim normalno da se već kao dijete upiše u klasu Optimist u jedriličarkom klubu Opatija. U mlađim uzrastima Enrico nije postizao zapažene sportske rezultate, ali se zato zaljubio u sport i jedrenje što je bila odlična podloga za jedrenje na dasci u kojem je s nepunih 19 godina postao državni prvak. Strast za jedrenjem, upornost i rad doveli su ga blizu svjetskog vrha. Cilj mu je, kaže, doći do samog vrha i tamo se zadržati. R.: Relja Dušek Ul.: Enrico Marotti (Self)...

Ubrzo otkrije da se tamo skupljaju sumnjive osobe i dogovaraju mutni poslovi. Naime, krčma je baza bandi koja mami brodove na stijene da se razbiju i zatim ih pljačkaju. Mary se počinje bojati za svoj život... R.: Alfred Hitchcock Ul.: Charles Laughton (Sir Humphrey Pengallan), Horace Hodges (Chadwick - Sir Humphreys Butler), Maureen OHara (Mary), Hay Petrie (Sam - Sir Humphreys Groom), Robert Newton (James "Jem" Trehearne)...

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: ART - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Art - Your Culture Address! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 8.10pm, we bring you the best from the art world and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music ... / ART - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Art - vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of the format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2024), a born Dubrovnik woman, who spent every weekend with her siblings on Peljesac - on Draca, where her mother led them to work in the field, today she says that the time when they planted and picked her own patatas, the pomaders and oranges greatly formed and determined. The guest of the show is Katarina Ivanisa's Kardum, an artist who feels nature, admires the mountains and respects the bees, and she has all woven it into her paintings, installations and everyday life. The current exhibition of Katarina Ivanisin Kardum in the Spot Gallery is spoken by art historian Sandra Križić Roban, and we were at a hotel in the center of Zagreb, where there are two wall installations of this versatile artist recently. R.: Vesna Lukovic Žarno ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2024) Rođena Dubrovčanka, koja je kao dijete svaki vikend s braćom i sestrom provodila na Pelješcu - na Draču, kamo ih je majka vodila da rade u polju, danas kaže da ju je vrijeme kada su sadili i brali vlastite patate, pomadore i narančine uvelike oblikovalo i odredilo. Gošća emisije je Katarina Ivanišin Kardum, umjetnica koja osjeća prirodu, divi se planinama i poštuje pčele, a sve je to utkala u svoje slike, instalacije i svakodnevni život. O aktualnoj izložbi Katarine Ivanišin Kardum u Galeriji Spot govori povjesničarka umjetnosti Sandra Križić Roban, a bili smo i u hotelu u središtu Zagreba gdje se odnedavno nalaze dvije zidne instalacije ove svestrane umjetnice. R.: Vesna Luković Žarn...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2021) Poetry collection in two votes is a rare event in literature. Andrijana Kos Lajtman's "contagious zone" and Damir Radic is exactly such a collection. Pandemi and earthquake were triggers scientists and poets Andrijani Kos Lajtman and poet, filmmaker and critic Damir Radic for the poetic design of a common everyday life, in which, in the process of closing the world, ordinary things such as haircuts or walks were completely new. In the sequel to the show, get to know the travel poem Maja Klarić, who travels in the old van into a bookmobile where poetry may not be easily accessible or where people do not read it and do not exchanged books ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2021) Pjesnička zbirka u dva glasa rijedak je događaj u književnosti. "Zarazna zona" Andrijane Kos Lajtman i Damira Radića upravo je takva zbirka. Pandemija i potres bili su okidači znanstvenici i pjesnikinji Andrijani Kos Lajtman i pjesniku, filmskom autoru i kritičaru Damiru Radiću za pjesničko oblikovanje zajedničke svakodnevice u kojoj su, u procesu zatvaranja svijeta, obične stvari poput šišanja ili šetnje dobile posve nova značenja. U nastavku emisije upoznajte putopjesnikinju Maju Klarić koja u starom kombiju pretvorenom u Bookmobil putuje tamo gdje poezija možda nije lako dostupna ili gdje je ljudi baš ne čitaju i ne razmjenjuju knjige...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) World -renowned Serbian baritone Željko Lucic in the 2023/2024 season. He was an opera artist of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb. On this occasion, we watched him in his most sought after roles of Verdi's opera Rigoletto and Nabucco, in the acclaimed productions of the Zagreb Opera. For the end of the season, with selected colleagues from the Zagreb Opera, he made a spectacular concert of the Opera Gala, which also presented the latest acquisition of the ensemble, Serbian mezzo -soprano Sofia Petrovic. The Zagreb HNK ensemble was conducted by the Honorary Chief of the Zagreb Opera, the Italian Maestro Pier-Giorgio Morandi, whom Lucic knows well from Metropolitan and La Scale. By the way, this new director of the Belgrade Opera began fertile cooperation with our theater manifested in the exchanges of guest appearances. After the Belgrade Opera Ensemble has closed the second Zagreb opera Festival this September by performing Verdi's Simon Boccanegre in Zagreb, the Zagreb Opera will play at their theater in Belgrade on Wednesday, October 16, 2024, with the most performed Croatian opera, Era from that world of James Gotovac. Between these two for Croatian culture, historical events, present Zeljko Lucic and his thinking about opera art, memories of his only professor of solo singing, Croatian mezzo -soprano Biserka Cvejić and friendship with Maestrome Morandi ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Svjetski poznati srpski bariton Željko Lučić u sezoni 2023./2024. bio je operni umjetnik sezone Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu. Tim povodom smo ga gledali u njegovim najtraženijim naslovnim ulogama Verdijevih opera Rigoletto i Nabucco, u hvaljenim produkcijama Zagrebačke opere. Za kraj sezone, s odabranim kolegama iz zagrebačke opere, napravio je spektakularni koncert Opere gala na kojemu se predstavila i najnovija akvizicija ansambla, srpska mezzosopranistica Sofija Petrović. Ansamblom zagrebačkoga HNK dirigirao je počasni šef-dirigent zagrebačke opere, talijanski maestro Pier-Giorgio Morandi kojega Lučić dobro poznaje iz Metropolitana i La scale. Inače, taj je novi direktor beogradske opere započeo plodnu suradnju s našim kazalištem koja se očituje u razmjenama gostovanja. Nakon što je ansambl beogradske opere ovoga rujna zatvorio Drugi Zagrebački operni festival izvedbom Verdijeva Simona Boccanegre u Zagrebu, zagrebačka opera gostovat će u njihovom kazalištu u Beogradu u srijedu, 16. listopada 2024., s najizvođenijom hrvatskom operom, Erom s onoga svijeta Jakova Gotovca. Između ta dva za hrvatsku kulturu povijesna događaja, predstavljamo Željka Lučića i njegova razmišljanja o opernoj umjetnosti, sjećanja na njegovu jedinu profesoricu solopjevanja, hrvatsku mezzosopranisticu Biserku Cvejić i prijateljstvu s maestrom Morandijem...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2025) Like it or not to us, jazz is, in addition to being beautiful music, and a kind of musical business that is not profitable as other genres, implies a global network of publishing, promoter, artistic and other jobs. At this level, like any industry, jazz needs gatherings where there is not so much music in the forefront, how to get acquainted, connecting, promoting and networking. Among such gatherings, the JazzaHead Fair is especially emphasized!, Which is held once a year in the German city of Bremen. Since 2006, when it was launched, jazzahead! has turned into one of the most important encounters of all those who make up the ecosystem of jazz: musicians, publishing houses, agents, festival organizers, journalists and others. In addition to the fair, where participants represent themselves on their stands, jazzahead! It also includes conferences and showcase performances and a festival concert program. These are about 3000 professional delegates from 66 countries around the world and 14,000 visitors. This year Jazzahead! entitled "Reconnect" held from April 24 to April 26, with numerous guests, presentations and talks on current topics, but it is important for us to participate in the official delegation from the Croatian Export Exports Office, including Lana Janjanin as a jury member of the German Jazz Expo, a program intended for the German Jazz Scene. With the recent cooperation of the Jazz Festival in Monterey and Dubrovnik, it is proof that our jazz scenes are increasingly involved in international streams. We can only add to that - well deserved ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Sviđalo se to nama ili ne, jazz je, osim što je predivna glazba, i neka vrsta glazbenog biznisa koji, premda nije profitabilan kao neki drugi žanrovi, podrazumijeva globalnu mrežu izdavačkih, promotorskih, umjetničkih i drugih poslova. Na toj razini, kao i svakoj industriji, jazzu su potrebna okupljanja na kojima u prvom planu nije toliko sama glazba, koliko upoznavanje, povezivanje, promocija i umrežavanje. Među takvim okupljanjima posebno se ističe sajam Jazzahead!, koji se jednom godišnje održava u njemačkom gradu Bremenu. Od 2006. godine, kada je pokrenut, Jazzahead! se pretvorio u jedan od najvažnijih susreta svih onih koji čine ekosustav jazza: muzičara, izdavačkih kuća, agenata, festivalskih organizatora, novinara i drugih. Uz sajamski dio, na kojem se sudionici predstavljaju na svojim štandovima, Jazzahead! obuhvaća i konferencije te showcase nastupe i festivalski koncertni program. Riječ je o oko 3000 profesionalnih delegata iz 66 zemalja cijelog svijeta te 14.000 posjetitelja. Ove se godine Jazzahead! pod nazivom "Reconnect" održao od 24. do 26. travnja, uz brojne goste, predstavljanja i razgovore o aktualnim temama, no za nas je važno zbog sudjelovanja službene delegacije iz Ureda za izvoz glazbe Hrvatska, uključujući i Lanu Janjanin kao članicu žirija German Jazz Expoa, programa namijenjenog njemačkoj jazz sceni. Uz recentnu suradnju jazz festivala u Montereyu i Dubrovniku, dokaz je to da se naša jazz scena sve više uključuje u međunarodne tokove. Tome možemo samo dodati - posve zasluženo...

programme.title: Jerôme: A look into the blue / Jerôme: Pogled u plavetnilo
programme.desc: Jerôme, Les Yeux Dans Le Bleu - (E03, Doc. Film, France, 2022) Jerôme Delafosse is printed towards Peru to live a day with peoples whose social balance, economy and ecology are based on the water cycle. He begins his journey on the shores of Amazon, where he meets the Matses Indian tribe, the Jaguar tribe, whose life is determined by the rhythm of Rijeka. Jerôme reveals that they have developed different methods of hunting, fishing and agriculture, certainly with an increase or reduction of the amount of water, and that every wealth offered by the forest, such as the Zaba Camp, allows them to create a symbiotic relationship with the environment. Jerôme then goes to Soce Paucartambo where he meets Qerose, guards of glaciers. There, at an altitude of 5,000 meters, he realizes how important these huge ice areas are, which supply that desert area with water and create conditions suitable for the cultivation of alpacas and agricultural cultures. Before leaving, they take it to the top of the Ande mountain range, where he participates in the rite in honor of the spirit of the patron saint of Ausangate glaciers. They all begging him together to slow the dissolution of glaciers due to the ash resulting in large fires that engulfed the Amazon forest. The ashes are deposited on the glaciers because of the rain. R .: Jerôme Delafosse ... / Jerôme, les yeux dans le bleu - (E03, dok. film, Francuska, 2022) Jerôme Delafosse se otiskuje prema Peruu kako bi proživio dan s narodima čija se društvena ravnoteža, gospodarstvo i ekologija temelje na ciklusu vode. Svoje putovanje počinje na obalama Amazone, gdje susreće indijansko pleme Matses, pleme jaguara, čiji je život određen ritmom rijeke. Jerôme otkriva kako su razvili različite metode lova, ribolova i poljoprivrede, određene porastom ili smanjenjem količine vode te kako im svako bogatstvo koje im šuma nudi, poput žabe kambo, omogućava stvaranje simbiotske veze s okolišem. Jerôme zatim odlazi u seoce Paucartambo gdje susreće Qerose, čuvare ledenjaka. Ondje, na visini od 5000 metara, shvaća koliko su važne te goleme ledene površine, koje taj pustinjski kraj opskrbljuju vodom i stvaraju uvjete pogodne za uzgoj alpaka i poljoprivrednih kultura. Prije odlaska, odvode ga do vrha planinskog lanca Anda gdje sudjeluje u obredu u čast duha zaštitnika ledenjaka Ausangatea. Svi zajedno mole ga da uspori otapanje ledenjaka zbog pepela nastalog u velikim požarima koji su zahvatili šumu Amazone. Pepeo se taloži na ledenjacima zbog kiše. R.: Jerôme Delafosse...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: The time for jazz - (music. Show, Croatia, 2022) at the Zagreb Culture Factory on March 16, 2022, in the Jazzhr Society of Composers, Multiinstrumentalist, vocalist, vocal pedagogue, arranger and composer Sandra Haluzan, with her quartet, the promotional performance of her first album, who recorded her first album. Joe Kaplowitz, double bass player Bojan Skilicic and drummer Antun Profet. This composition composes and performs jazz arrangements of indigenous Zagorje compositions, as well as the author's compositions on indigenous Kajkavian language that Sandra arranged in the new jazz and blues style. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2022) U zagrebačkoj Tvornici kulture 16. ožujka 2022. godine, u sezoni JazzHR Hrvatskog društva skladatelja, multiinstrumentalistica, vokalistica, vokalna pedagoginja, aranžerka i skladateljica Sandra Halužan održala je sa svojim kvartetom promotivni nastup svog prvog albuma Vu plavem koji je snimila s klaviristom Joeom Kaplowitzom, kontrabasistom Bojanom Skočilićem i bubnjarem Antunom Profetom. U tom sastavu komponira i izvodi jazz-aranžmane autohtonih zagorskih skladbi, te autorske skladbe na autohtonom kajkavskom jeziku koje je Sandra aranžirala u novom jazz i blues stilu. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: The reader club / Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: The reader club - (Art Magazine, Croatia, 2025) in the study show "Club of Readers" every week will be discussed one title that is currently read in Croatia. The reader club on Prisavlje, with eminent critics and theorists, will include passionate readers from various cities and various areas of life, retirees, students, high school students, bloggers, professors, athletes, entrepreneurs, artists, libraries and all those who still believe that the book is the best thing in life. Become a part of our club! ... / Klub čitatelja - (umjetnički magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) U studijskoj emisiji "Klub čitatelja" svakog će se tjedna razgovarati o jednom naslovu koji se trenutačno čita u Hrvatskoj. Čitateljski klub na Prisavlju, uz eminentne kritičare i teoretičare, uključivat će strastvene čitatelje iz raznih gradova i raznih područja života, umirovljenike, studente, srednjoškolce, blogere, profesore, sportaše, poduzetnike, umjetnike, bibliotekare i sve one koji još uvijek vjeruju da je knjiga najbolja stvar u životu. Postanite i vi dio našeg Kluba!...

programme.title: Jerôme: A look into the blue / Jerôme: Pogled u plavetnilo
programme.desc: Jerôme, Les Yeux Dans Le Bleu - (E04, Doc. Film, France, 2023) British Columbia is world -famous for its enchanting landscapes and beautiful protected natural areas. Numerous peoples of British Columbia are tied to the water because they live along the edge of the Pacific Ocean, and the soil is covered with magnificent lakes and rivers. Jerôme Delafosse is looking for them on the huge island of Vancouver. The trip first takes him to the south of the island, where he divers in the Pacific Ocean among the giant octopus with Tiare Boyes, a professional diver, a submarine photographer and environmental patron. Then he goes to Tofino where he spends a typical day with Wayne and Catherine in their unusual floating house in Liberty Bay. Nearby is Lenny and Marcy, a couple of activists with whom Roni near the salmon farm. There he realizes what an ecological catastrophe this industry causes in the sea ecosystem. Finally he goes to the Cowichan reserve, where he is taught by a traditional harpoon hunt. So they hunt every year when the salmon return to the river rapids to spawn. R .: Jerôme Delafosse ... / Jerôme, les yeux dans le bleu - (E04, dok. film, Francuska, 2023) Britanska Kolumbija svjetski je poznata zbog svojih očaravajućih krajolika i prelijepih zaštićenih prirodnih područja. Brojni narodi Britanske Kolumbije vezani su uz vodu jer žive uz rub Tihog oceana, a tlo je prekriveno veličanstvenim jezerima i rijekama. Jerôme Delafosse ih traži na golemom otoku Vancouveru. Putovanje ga najprije vodi na jug otoka gdje roni u Tihom oceanu među divovskim hobotnicama s Tiareom Boyes, profesionalnim roniocem, fotografkinjom podmorja i zaštitnicom okoliša. Zatim odlazi u Tofino gdje provodi tipičan dan s Wayneom i Catherine u njihovoj neobičnoj plutajućoj kući u Uvali slobode. U blizini se nalazi s Lennyjem i Marcy, parom aktivista s kojima roni u blizini farme za uzgoj lososa. Ondje shvaća kakvu ekološku katastrofu ta industrija izaziva u morskom ekosustavu. Naposljetku odlazi u rezervat Cowichan, gdje ga poučavaju tradicionalnom lovu harpunom. Tako love svake godine kad se lososi vraćaju uz riječne brzace kako bi se mrijestili. R.: Jerôme Delafosse...

programme.title: Alaina Delona Retrospective: Death of corrupt rats / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Smrt korumpiranog štakora
programme.desc: Mort Dun Pourri - (Crimea. Film, France, 1977) Philippe Dubaya kills the famous political blackmail, and his friend Xav gives him a fictional alibi. The police do not send it, but Dubaye dues when Xav goes to his mistress on a contracted meeting, where he will try to abduct him from the financial and political underground to him to destroy or destroy them. Very quickly becomes clear that behind the mask of reputable people from civil society - businessmen, representatives, and even the Minister hide criminals on the edge of crime and public Sklard. R.: Georges Lautner Str.: Alain Delon (Xavier Xav Marechal), Stephane Audran (Christiane), Ornella Muti (Valerie), Mireille Darc (Françoise), Maurice Dubaye ... / Mort dun pourri - (krim. film, Francuska, 1977) Zastupnik Philippe Dubaye ubija poznatoga političkog ucjenjivača, a njegov mu prijatelj Xav daje izmišljeni alibi. Policija na to ne nasjeda, no Dubaye pogiba u trenutku kada Xav s njegovom ljubavnicom odlazi na ugovoreni sastanak, gdje će doći do dosjea koji će mu svim silama nastojati oteti ljudi iz finacijskog i političkog podzemlja da bi ih ili uništili ili iskoristili u mračne svrhe. Vrlo brzo postaje jasno da se iza maske uglednih ljudi iz građanskog društva - biznismena, zastupnika, pa čak i ministra kriju kriminalci stalno na rubu zločina i javnog sklandala. R.: Georges Lautner Ul.: Alain Delon (Xavier Xav Marechal), Stephane Audran (Christiane), Ornella Muti (Valerie), Mireille Darc (Françoise), Maurice Ronet (Philippe Dubaye)...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2013) Gonogo, Zagreb Band, is created as a result of the friendship and musical twinning of Tomislav Snidaric, guitarist and vocals one of the most exciting Croatian indie bands, former Ruis, and Zdravko Savor, guitarist of the Zagreb Punk Band. Before that, Zdravko was a member of a series of Undergrounds (Garage Monsters and Parusia). The collective is rounded off by Basista Ivana Vodanovic, who has also been active in many bands in the past years (Let's Memorial Don Mess With Texas and Mutual of Omaha) and former Ruizov and current Embandh Bubnish Janko Kezele. In 2011, they published the first EP First, and in early October this year, the second EP Second. Their first record label is accompanied by positive reviews, and as songs from the new EP sound, listen to the gorge live: follow, All at Once, Crowd, Homeless Man, Secret Little Sign, Tommy Boy, Rate ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2013) GoNoGo, zagrebački band, nastaje kao rezultat prijateljstva i glazbenog pobratimstva Tomislava Šnidarića, gitarista i vokala jednog od najuzbudljivijih hrvatskih indie bandova, bivšeg Ruiza, i Zdravka Šavora, gitarista zagrebačkog punk benda Kipera. Zdravko je prije toga bio član niza underground uzdanica (Garage Monsters i Paruziju). Kolektiv zaokružuju basistica Ivana Vodanović koja je u proteklim godinama također bila aktivna u mnogim bandovima (spomenimo Dont Mess With Texas i Mutual Of Omaha) te bivši Ruizov i aktualni EBandHH bubnjar Janko Kezele. Godine 2011. objavljuju prvi EP First, a početkom listopada ove godine i drugi EP Second. Njihovo prvo diskografsko ostvarenje popraćeno je pozitivnim recenzijama, a kako zvuče pjesme s novog EP-a, poslušajte uživo u Garaži: FOLLOW, ALL AT ONCE, CROWD, HOMELESS MAN, SECRET LITTLE SIGN, TOMMY BOY, RATE...

programme.title: Millennium trilogy / Trilogija Millennium
programme.desc: Millennium - (E05, Crimea series, Denmark, 2010) Two seriously injured persons were received at the Sahlgrenska Emergency Reception Hospital in Gotheborg. One of them is the killer from the arrest warrant Lisbeth Salander, who is hit by a bullet in the head and has to have an emergency; The other person is Alexander Zalachenko, an elderly man who was attacked by Lisbeth with an ax. Lisbeth dreams revenge on men who have inflicted evil and, more importantly, revenge on the state system who ruined her life. R .: Daniel Alfredson Ul.: Noomi Rapace (Lisbeth Salander), Michael Nyqvist (Mikael Blomkvist), Lena Endre (Erika Berger), Peter Anderson (Nils Bjurman), Sofia Ledarp (Malin Erixon) ... / Millennium - (E05, krim. serija, Danska, 2010) Dvije teško ozlijeđene osobe zaprimljene su na hitni prijem bolnice Sahlgrenska u Goteborgu. Jedna od njih je ubojica s tjeralice Lisbeth Salander, koja je pogođena metkom u glavu i mora na hitnu operaciju; druga osoba je Aleksandar Zalačenko, stariji muškarac kojeg je Lisbeth napala sjekirom. Lisbeth snuje osvetu muškarcima koji su joj nanijeli zlo i, još važnije, osvetu državnom sustavu koji joj je upropastio život. R.: Daniel Alfredson Ul.: Noomi Rapace (Lisbeth Salander), Michael Nyqvist (Mikael Blomkvist), Lena Endre (Erika Berger), Peter Andersson (Nils Bjurman), Sofia Ledarp (Malin Erikson)...

programme.title: Rome mother / Mama Roma
programme.desc: Mamma Roma - (Drama, Italy, 1962) Roman prostitute Mamma Roma decides to change the lifestyle and stop dealing with renting her body. He goes for the son of Ettore, who she gave up on the upbringing of a rural family to remain aside from her life. programme.title: Put neandertalca / Put neandertalca
programme.desc: Neanderthal's path - (E02, known. Pop. Film, Croatia, 2013) The movie "The Way of the Neanderthal" is based on the project of the same name launched by archaeologist mr. sc. Sanjin Mihelić from the Archaeological Museum in Zagreb, in cooperation with prof. Ivor Karavanić from the Faculty of Philosophy, Zagreb and Ph.D. Ivor Jankovic from the Institute of Anthropology. The idea of ​​a project, including our film, is appropriately evaluating the Croatian Neanderthal heritage and put it in the context of a broader cultural offer. The HRT team with the authors of the project and a group of archeology students visited all the more important Neanderthal sites in Croatia, some of which be transcended by the frameworks of national science. We did not neglect the other component of the Put Neanderthal project, so we visited interesting and valuable cultural and historical monuments near Neanderthal sites. ----- In the second part, we traveled the south of Croatia, from the Ljubački Gulf-Veliki Open site, through the Greater Czech Republic near Benkovac and Mujina Cave in the Kastela hinterland to Restnik in Kastela, so far the only underwater site of Neanderthals in us. R.: Mladen Capin ... / Put neandertalca - (E02, znan. pop. film, Hrvatska, 2013) Film "Put neandertalca" temelji se na istoimenom projektu koji je pokrenuo arheolog mr. sc. Sanjin Mihelić iz Arheološkog muzeja u Zagrebu, u suradnji s prof dr. sc. Ivorom Karavanićem s Filozofskog fakulteta, Zagreb i dr. sc. Ivorom Jankovićem s Instituta za antropologiju. Ideja je projekta, pa tako i našeg filma, na odgovarajući način vrednovati hrvatsku neandertalsku baštinu i staviti je u kontekst šire kulturne ponude. Ekipa HRT-a s autorima projekta i grupom studenata arheologije obišla je sva važnija neandertalska nalazišta u Hrvatskoj, od kojih neka nadilaze okvire nacionalne znanosti. Nismo zanemarili ni drugu komponentu projekta Put neandertalca, pa smo obišli zanimljive i vrijedne kulturno-povijesne spomenike u blizini neandertalskih nalazišta. ----- U drugom dijelu proputovali smo jug Hrvatske, od Ljubačkog zaljeva - velikog nalazišta na otvorenom, preko Velike pećine Kličevice kod Benkovca i Mujine pećine u kaštelanskom zaleđu do Resnika u Kaštelima, zasad jedinog podvodnog nalazišta neandertalca u nas. R.: Mladen Ćapin...

Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: These houses had their soul / Te kuće su imale svoju dušu
programme.desc: These houses had their soul - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2019) When you know a lot and you want to make, and the time ahead is small, you experience life more intensely, and you try to summarize your mission in this world just like Nikola Zrinšćak. He is a master and artist from Lazina who has saved wooden houses all his life, valuable specimens of Croatian traditional architecture because he always felt that "these houses had their own soul." R .: Tihana Kopsa ... / Te kuće su imale svoju dušu - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2019) Kad puno toga znate i želite napraviti, a vremena pred vama je malo, život doživljavate intenzivnije, a svoju misiju na ovom svijetu pokušavate rezimirati baš kao Nikola Zrinšćak. On je majstor i umjetnik iz Lazine koji je cijeloga života spašavao drvene kuće, vrijedne primjerke hrvatske tradicijske arhitekture jer je uvijek osjećao da su "te kuće imale svoju dušu". R.: Tihana Kopsa...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2021) The guest of the show is director and screenwriter Rajko Grlic, with whom we will talk about the book of the stories and memory of his mother. "Memories and other unpublished stories" Eve Grlić is a diary of one space and time in which she described memories of her childhood, participation in the workers' movement and horrors during the NDH, staying in the partisans, the horrific experience of Gologna Island, work in socialist factories and newspapers, and gathering with intellectuals from the former state and Europe, in which she participated with her wife. In the continuation of the show, we continue to talk about the turbulent events of the 20th century with Helen Janeczek, winner of the most prestigious Italian literary award of Straga. The "Lico Girl" is Kaleidoscopically a novel about Gerda Taro, photographer and anti -fascist heroine. At the same time, a fixed biography and a strong account of the 1930s with the financial crisis and the rise of Nazism ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2021) Gost emisije je redatelj i scenarist Rajko Grlić s kojim ćemo razgovarati o knjizi priča i uspomena njegove majke. "Sjećanja i druge neobjavljene priče" Eve Grlić dnevnik su jednog prostora i vremena u kojem je opisala uspomene na svoje djetinjstvo, sudjelovanje u radničkom pokretu i strahote za vrijeme NDH, boravak u partizanima, stravično iskustvo Golog otoka, rad u socijalističkim tvornicama i novinama te druženja s intelektualcima iz bivše države i Europe, u kojima je sudjelovala zajedno sa suprugom, filozofom Dankom Grlićem. U nastavku emisije nastavljamo razgovor o turbulentnim događajima 20. stoljeća s Helenom Janeczek, dobitnicom najprestižnije talijanske književne nagrade Strega. "Djevojka s Leicom" kaleidoskopski je roman o Gerdi Taro, fotografkinji i antifašističkoj heroini. Istovremeno fikcionalizirana biografija i snažan prikaz 30-ih godina prošlog stoljeća s financijskom krizom i usponom nacizma...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2023) Opera Selecta is already a traditional summer festival that is organized by its citizens, primeval opera lovers, in Trogir with the selected opera artists. According to the member of the Organizing Committee, Natalija Vukelic reveals to us, in its jubilee 15. At the opening of the excerpt from Gershwin's "Porty and Bess", as well as other contemporary vocal achievements, Zagreb's soprano Darija Augustan is being performed with a stylish open ensemble Acostic Project and his artistic leader - a double bass player and composer Dubravko Palanovic. The highlight of the organizational effort was to host on the open scene of the Kamerlengo Tower of the HRT Symphony Orchestra in the opera program program in which the favorite opera fragments under the conductor of Maestro Paul Zajcev are performed by sopranoist Marija Kuhar Šoša, Tenor Filip Filipović and MezzoSoSopranica Teresa Teresa Kusanović. Without the wholehearted support of the citizens of the City of Trogir and his Mayor Ante Bilic Opera, there would be no in that historic UNESCO city. We are revealed to us by the manager of HRT's Working Unit by Ivana Kocelj, then pianist and professor of piano Olga Cinkoburova, professor of history Ivo Dellale, art historian Andro Krstulovic Opara, and finally Split Mayor Ivica Puljak ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2023) Opera Selecta već je tradicionalni ljetni festival koji u Trogiru s probranim opernim umjetnicima organiziraju njegovi građani, iskonski zaljubljenici u operu. Kako nam otkriva članica organizacijskog odbora Natalija Vukelić, u svojem jubilarnom 15. izdanju festival hrvatskim snagama dokazuje naš dobro etablirani položaj u svijetu opere. Na otvorenju ulomke iz Gershwinove "Porty and Bess", ali i drugih suvremenijih vokalnih ostvarenja izvode sve traženija zagrebačka sopranistica Darija Auguštan uz stilski otvoreni ansambl Acoustic Project i njegova umjetničkog voditelja - kontrabasista i skladatelja Dubravka Palanovića. Vrhunac organizacijskog napora bilo je ugostiti na otvorenoj sceni kule Kamerlengo cijeli Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a u opera-gala programu u kojemu omiljene operne ulomke pod dirigentskim vodstvom maestra Pavla Zajceva izvode sopranistica Marija Kuhar Šoša, tenor Filip Filipović i mezzosopranistica Terezija Kusanović. Bez svesrdne podrške građana grada Trogira i njegova gradonačelnika Ante Bilića opere ne bi bilo u tom povijesnom UNESCO-vu gradu. Svoje dojmove s prošloljetnog opernog Trogira kroz emisiju nam otkrivaju rukovoditeljica HRT-ove radne jedinice Glazba Ivana Kocelj, zatim pijanistica i profesorica klavira Olga Cinkoburova, profesor povijesti Ivo Dellale, povjesničar umjetnosti Andro Krstulović Opara te naposljetku splitski gradonačelnik Ivica Puljak...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2025) Although by age, what his surname means - old school - Barry Altschul to gig and spirit is certainly not. This charismatic 82-year-old, from which New York attitude and directness flip through, does not at all be mystified what he does, though, given his merits, he might be able to. And this is a truly glittering career, which mostly stand out for collaborations with Paul Bley, Anthony Braxton, Chick Corea and Rives himself. Already, this list of the most prominent musical coats suggests that Altschul, as part of the generation that established itself on the jazz scene in the second half of the 1960s and 70s, strongly leaned out of free and avant-garde jazz, which will be spiritually remained today. In Novi Millenni, one of the central projects is Fab Trio, who is launching with violinist Billy Bang and the double bassist Joe Fund. He releases five albums with them, but unfortunately the exciting collaboration is interrupted by Bang's death in April 2011 next year, Altschul and the Fund find a new associate in the form of a fantastic saxophonist Jon Irabagon, with which they now form 3DO Factor. These three angles of music freedom are a fantastic blend of spontaneity, virtuosity and the most beautiful musicality, demonstrating in early May at the Swamp Club, performing as part of an irreplaceable implementation program under the guidance of Damir Price Caprija Kafka ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Premda po godinama jest ono što njegovo prezime znači - stara škola - Barry Altschul to svirkom i duhom sasvim sigurno nije. Taj karizmatični 82-godišnjak, iz kojeg frcaju njujorški stav i direktnost, nimalo ne mistificira to što radi, premda bi, s obzirom na njegove zasluge, to možda i mogao. A radi se o uistinu blistavoj karijeri, u kojoj se ponajviše izdvajaju suradnje s Paulom Bleyom, Anthonyjem Braxtonom, Chickom Coreaom i Samom Riversom. Već i ovaj popis najistaknutijih muzičkih sudrugova sugerira da je Altschul, kao dio generacije koja se na jazz sceni etablirala u drugoj polovici 60-ih i 70-ih, snažno naginjao free i avangardnom jazzu, kojima će duhovno ostati odan dan-danas. U novom mileniju, jedan od središnjih projekata mu je FAB Trio, koji pokreće s violinistom Billyjem Bangom i kontrabasistom Joeom Fondom. S njima objavljuje pet albuma, no tu uzbudljivu suradnju nažalost prekida Bangova smrt u travnju 2011. Iduće godine Altschul i Fonda pronalaze novog suradnika u obličju fantastičnog saksofonista Jona Irabagona, s kojim sada formiraju 3dom Factor. Ta tri ugla muzičke slobode fantastičan su spoj spontanosti, virtuoznosti i najljepše muzikalnosti, što su demonstrirali početkom svibnja u klubu Močvara, nastupivši u sklopu nezamjenjivog programa Impronedjeljci pod vodstvom Damira Price Caprija Kafke...

programme.title: Jerôme: A look into the blue / Jerôme: Pogled u plavetnilo
programme.desc: Jerôme, Les Yeux Dans Le Bleu - (E04, Doc. Film, France, 2023) British Columbia is world -famous for its enchanting landscapes and beautiful protected natural areas. Numerous peoples of British Columbia are tied to the water because they live along the edge of the Pacific Ocean, and the soil is covered with magnificent lakes and rivers. Jerôme Delafosse is looking for them on the huge island of Vancouver. The trip first takes him to the south of the island, where he divers in the Pacific Ocean among the giant octopus with Tiare Boyes, a professional diver, a submarine photographer and environmental patron. Then he goes to Tofino where he spends a typical day with Wayne and Catherine in their unusual floating house in Liberty Bay. Nearby is Lenny and Marcy, a couple of activists with whom Roni near the salmon farm. There he realizes what an ecological catastrophe this industry causes in the sea ecosystem. Finally he goes to the Cowichan reserve, where he is taught by a traditional harpoon hunt. So they hunt every year when the salmon return to the river rapids to spawn. R .: Jerôme Delafosse ... / Jerôme, les yeux dans le bleu - (E04, dok. film, Francuska, 2023) Britanska Kolumbija svjetski je poznata zbog svojih očaravajućih krajolika i prelijepih zaštićenih prirodnih područja. Brojni narodi Britanske Kolumbije vezani su uz vodu jer žive uz rub Tihog oceana, a tlo je prekriveno veličanstvenim jezerima i rijekama. Jerôme Delafosse ih traži na golemom otoku Vancouveru. Putovanje ga najprije vodi na jug otoka gdje roni u Tihom oceanu među divovskim hobotnicama s Tiareom Boyes, profesionalnim roniocem, fotografkinjom podmorja i zaštitnicom okoliša. Zatim odlazi u Tofino gdje provodi tipičan dan s Wayneom i Catherine u njihovoj neobičnoj plutajućoj kući u Uvali slobode. U blizini se nalazi s Lennyjem i Marcy, parom aktivista s kojima roni u blizini farme za uzgoj lososa. Ondje shvaća kakvu ekološku katastrofu ta industrija izaziva u morskom ekosustavu. Naposljetku odlazi u rezervat Cowichan, gdje ga poučavaju tradicionalnom lovu harpunom. Tako love svake godine kad se lososi vraćaju uz riječne brzace kako bi se mrijestili. R.: Jerôme Delafosse...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Mundi Classics - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2023) The National Festival of the Varaždin Baroque Evenings is the most significant music and stage event of central Croatia, founded in 1971, and today it is one of the most modern festivals of its kind in the world. From the partner's country - Switzerland, at the opening of the 53rd VBV 2023, a great La Cetra Baroque Orchestra from Basel, which was founded in 1999 at the initiative of former Schola Cantorum Basiliensis Director Dr. Peter Reidemeister. The name La Cetra (Citra) is a borrowed title of Vivaldi's concerts for the violin op. 9, and refers to the basic repertoire of the orchestra - the Italian instrumental music of the 18th century. In 2009, when Andrea Marcon, whose ensemble owed its dynamic development, appointed conductor of La Cetre, its repertoire began to spread from the early Baroque to the 19th century. La Cetra is one of the leading orchestras in the world with international performances in the most significant concert halls, such as Concertgebouw Amsterdam, Philharmonie de Paris, Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, Konzerthaus Vienna, and also acts as an opera orchestra. At our biggest and oldest festival of Baroque music, from the Varaždin Cathedral, excellent musicians under the artistic guidance of Andrea Marcon, presented themselves with the compositions of Amand Ivancic and Antoni Vivaldi, and were joined by soloists Carlos Mena, a counterenor, Jone Martinez, Soprano and the Croatian Radio and Choir. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Hrvatska, 2023) Nacionalni Festival Varaždinske barokne večeri najznačajnija je glazbeno-scenska priredba središnje Hrvatske, osnovana 1971., a danas je jedan od najeminentnijih festivala te vrste u svijetu. Iz zemlje partnera - Švicarske, na otvorenju 53. VBV 2023. godine nastupio je odličan La Cetra barokni orkestar iz Basela, koji je osnovan 1999. godine na inicijativu nekadašnjeg ravnatelja Schola Cantorum Basiliensis dr. Petera Reidemeistera. Naziv La Cetra (citra) posuđeni je naslov Vivaldijevih Koncerata za violinu op. 9, a odnosi se na temeljni repertoar orkestra - talijansku instrumentalnu glazbu 18. stoljeća. Godine 2009., kada je Andrea Marcon, kojem ansambl duguje svoj dinamički razvoj, imenovan dirigentom La Cetre, njezin se repertoar počeo širiti od ranog baroka do 19. stoljeća. La Cetra je jedan od vodećih orkestara u svijetu s međunarodnim nastupima u najznačajnijim koncertnim dvoranama, kao što su Concertgebouw Amsterdam, Philharmonie de Paris, Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, Konzerthaus Beč, a djeluje i kao operni orkestar. Na našem najvećem i najstarijem festivalu barokne glazbe, iz Varaždinske katedrale, izvrsni glazbenici pod umjetničkim vodstvom upravo Andrea Marcona, predstavili su se skladbama Amanda Ivančića te Antonija Vivaldija, a u izvedbi su im se pridružili solisti Carlos Mena, kontratenor, Jone Martinez, sopran te Zbor Hrvatske radiotelevizije. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: The opening ceremony of the 50th Samobor Music Evenings / Svečano otvorenje 50. Samoborskih glazbenih večeri
programme.desc: The opening ceremony of the 50th Samobor Music Evenings - (movie class. Music, Croatia, 2025) Samobor music autumn has been promoting top music art for five decades and has been transformed into a musical center where classic music and historical sights of the city are harmoniously connected. Over the years, the festival has developed into a national importance event, recognizable by the richness and quality of the program. In the Jubilee, 50th Festival Year, the solemn opening will be held before the altar of the parish church of Sv. Anastasia. The renowned ensemble of Zagreb soloists will perform, and in top -notch chamber music, they will be joined by one of the most sought after counterbalances on the international scene - Božo Paradžik. The repertoire of Zagreb soloists covers the works of Baroque, classic and romantic periods, as well as contemporary compositions. On this occasion, the works of J. S. Bacha, J. Brahms, F. Schubert, D. Pejačević, G. Puccini, A. Vivaldi and O. Respirhija will perform the works of J. Bacha. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Svečano otvorenje 50. Samoborskih glazbenih večeri - (film klas. glazbe, Hrvatska, 2025) Samoborska glazbena jesen već pet desetljeća promiče vrhunsku glazbenu umjetnost te Samobor pretvara u glazbeno središte u kojem se skladno povezuju klasična glazba i povijesne znamenitosti grada. Tijekom godina festival se razvio u manifestaciju nacionalnog značaja, prepoznatljivu po bogatstvu i kvaliteti programa.U jubilarnoj, 50. festivalskoj godini, svečano otvorenje održat će se pred oltarom župne crkve sv. Anastazije. Nastupit će renomirani ansambl Zagrebački solisti, a u vrhunskom komornom muziciranju pridružit će im se jedan od najtraženijih kontrabasista na međunarodnoj sceni - Božo Paradžik. Repertoar Zagrebačkih solista obuhvaća djela baroknog, klasičnog i romantičnog razdoblja, ali i suvremene skladbe. Ovom prigodom izvest će djela J. S. Bacha, J. Brahmsa, F. Schuberta, D. Pejačević, G. Puccinija, A. Vivaldija i O. Respighija. R.: Danko Volarić...
